Matches user-agent specific rules in robots.txt

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, create_engine, scrape

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(respect_robots_txt=True, user_agent="CrawlbergBot")
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.is_allowed)

asyncio.run(main())
```
